en: The Forum of CEOs of Federal Government Parastatals (FORCEPA) has mobilised more than 100,000 supporters to storm the Kaduna venue of the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign kick-off on Saturday, reaffirming its support for President Bola Tinubu and Vice President Kashim Shettima’s re-election in 2027.
